from src.nodes.base import BaseNode
from src.runtime.assets.semantic import get_asset_query_engine

class Hou_Mcp_Asset_Search(BaseNode):
    name = "hou_mcp_asset_search"

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-START]
        self.add_input("intent",       "string", widget_type="text")
        self.add_input("environment",  "string", widget_type="text")
        self.add_input("role",         "string", widget_type="text")
        self.add_input("storytelling", "string", widget_type="text")
        self.add_input("lookdev",      "string", widget_type="text")
        self.add_input("cinematic",    "string", widget_type="text")
        self.add_input("provider",     "string", widget_type="text")
        self.add_input("limit",        "int",    widget_type="int", default=20)
        self.add_output("assets",     "list")
        self.add_output("total",      "int")
        self.add_output("query_info", "any")
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-END]

    async def execute(self, inputs):
        intent      = str(inputs.get("intent") or "").strip()
        environment = str(inputs.get("environment") or "").strip()
        role        = str(inputs.get("role") or "").strip()
        storytelling= str(inputs.get("storytelling") or "").strip()
        lookdev     = str(inputs.get("lookdev") or "").strip()
        cinematic   = str(inputs.get("cinematic") or "").strip()
        provider    = str(inputs.get("provider") or "").strip()
        limit       = int(inputs.get("limit") or 20)
        try:
            engine = get_asset_query_engine()
            if intent and not any([environment, role, storytelling, lookdev, cinematic]):
                result = engine.query_intent(intent, limit=limit)
            else:
                result = engine.query(
                    text=intent,
                    environment=environment,
                    role=role,
                    storytelling=storytelling,
                    lookdev=lookdev,
                    cinematic=cinematic,
                    provider=provider,
                    limit=limit,
                )
            return {
                "assets":     result.assets,
                "total":      result.total,
                "query_info": result.to_dict(),
                "exec_out":   True,
            }
        except Exception as e:
            self.log_error(f"hou_mcp_asset_search failed: {e}")
            return {"assets": [], "total": 0, "query_info": {}, "exec_out": True}

def register_node():
    return Hou_Mcp_Asset_Search
